metas.name: Air
metas.description: The true story of Nike's gamble on rookie Michael Jordan and the creation of the Air Jordan empire. Directed by Ben Affleck.

metas.name: Saltburn
metas.description: A scholarship student (Barry Keoghan) grows infatuated with a charismatic aristocrat (Jacob Elordi) and spends a decadent, twisted summer at his family's estate.

metas.name: Road House
metas.description: Ex-UFC fighter Dalton (Jake Gyllenhaal) takes a bouncer job in the Florida Keys and runs afoul of a ruthless crime boss.

metas.name: The Idea of You
metas.description: A 40-year-old single mother (Anne Hathaway) begins a whirlwind romance with a 24-year-old pop star (Nicholas Galitzine).

metas.name: The Boys in the Boat
metas.description: The true story of the University of Washington's underdog rowing crew chasing gold at the 1936 Berlin Olympics. Directed by George Clooney.

metas.name: The Burial
metas.description: Based on a true story: a small funeral-home owner (Tommy Lee Jones) takes on a corporate giant, with flamboyant attorney Willie Gary (Jamie Foxx) arguing the case.

metas.name: Cassandro
metas.description: The true story of Saul Armendariz (Gael Garcia Bernal), the gay luchador who became the 'Liberace of Lucha Libre.'

metas.name: A Million Miles Away
metas.description: The inspiring true story of Jose Hernandez, who rose from migrant farmworker to NASA astronaut.

metas.name: The Tomorrow War
metas.description: A family man (Chris Pratt) is drafted into a war thirty years in the future, where humanity is losing to alien invaders.

metas.name: Coming 2 America
metas.description: Prince Akeem (Eddie Murphy) returns to America to find the son he never knew and groom him as heir to the throne of Zamunda.

metas.name: The Tender Bar
metas.description: A boy growing up on Long Island finds father figures among the regulars of his uncle's bar. Directed by George Clooney.

metas.name: Being the Ricardos
metas.description: One tense production week behind I Love Lucy, as Lucille Ball and Desi Arnaz face accusations and a marriage in crisis. Written and directed by Aaron Sorkin.

metas.name: I Want You Back
metas.description: Two freshly dumped thirty-somethings (Charlie Day, Jenny Slate) plot to sabotage their exes' new relationships - and fall for each other instead.

metas.name: Thirteen Lives
metas.description: Ron Howard's retelling of the heroic 2018 Thai cave rescue of the Wild Boars youth soccer team.

metas.name: Samaritan
metas.description: A young boy (Javon Walton) becomes convinced his reclusive neighbor (Sylvester Stallone) is a legendary superhero long thought dead.

metas.name: My Policeman
metas.description: A 1950s policeman (Harry Styles) marries a woman while secretly loving a man, in a sweeping romance spanning decades.

metas.name: Argentina, 1985
metas.description: The true story of the prosecutors who dared to put Argentina's military junta on trial after the fall of the dictatorship.

metas.name: Shotgun Wedding
metas.description: A destination wedding (Jennifer Lopez, Josh Duhamel) is taken hostage by pirates, forcing the bickering couple to fight to save their guests.

metas.name: Red, White & Royal Blue
metas.description: America's First Son falls for a British prince; their secret romance becomes a diplomatic crisis - and a love story.

metas.name: Totally Killer
metas.description: A teen time-travels to 1987 to stop the serial killer who murdered her friends' mothers - before he can strike again.

metas.name: The Underdoggs
metas.description: A washed-up NFL star (Snoop Dogg) coaches a pee-wee football team to dodge community service and rediscovers his love of the game.

metas.name: Upgraded
metas.description: An ambitious art-world intern's life changes when a first-class upgrade to London lands her a dream job - and a complicated new romance.

metas.name: Ricky Stanicky
metas.description: Three friends invent an imaginary pal to blame for their mischief, then must hire an actor (John Cena) to play him when their families demand a meeting.

metas.name: My Old Ass
metas.description: A teenager (Maisy Stella) meets her own 39-year-old self (Aubrey Plaza) on a mushroom trip and gets brutally honest life advice.

metas.name: You're Cordially Invited
metas.description: Two weddings accidentally double-book the same venue, pitting the bride's sister (Reese Witherspoon) against the other bride's father (Will Ferrell).

metas.name: Another Simple Favor
metas.description: Stephanie and Emily (Anna Kendrick, Blake Lively) reunite for a lavish Italian wedding - where murder crashes the party once again.

metas.name: Heads of State
metas.description: The US President (John Cena) and the UK Prime Minister (Idris Elba) must bury their rivalry to stop a global conspiracy.

metas.name: Deep Cover
metas.description: Three improv actors are recruited by London police to infiltrate the criminal underworld - using their improv skills to stay alive.
